title: Price Alerts & Watchlist — Solution Architecture
overview: Extends the TradeEasy mobile app and backend with a real-time price alert system and watchlist management across iOS, Android, and web. The architecture reuses the existing PostgreSQL (RDS) and Redis (ElastiCache) infrastructure and adds a stateless Alert Evaluator service running on ECS Fargate. All real-time quote data is sourced from Polygon.io via WebSocket.

backend.alternatives: IEX Cloud, Alpaca, self-built NYSE feed
backend.rationale: Best latency (< 500ms), simple WebSocket API, covers equities + ETFs; lowest integration cost
Low latency, no broker overhead at this throughput; Redis already in stack; consumer group gives at-least-once delivery
Free tier covers 100K/day; direct iOS/Android support without additional SDK
Already contracted; no new vendor or procurement cycle

infrastructure.rationale: Existing cluster; zero new infrastructure provisioning; Fargate spot for Alert Evaluator cost reduction
Relational model fits watchlist/alerts; avoids new data store operational overhead

entities.name: price_alerts
entities.key_fields: user_id UUID, ticker VARCHAR(10), target_price NUMERIC(12,4), direction ENUM(above/below), status ENUM(active/triggered/deleted), channel ENUM(push/email/both), triggered_at TIMESTAMPTZ, triggered_price NUMERIC(12,4)
entities.notes: Indexed on (ticker, status) for evaluator query; soft delete via status field

entities.name: alert_notifications
entities.key_fields: alert_id UUID, channel ENUM(push/email), status ENUM(sent/failed/delivered), sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ
entities.notes: Audit log for delivery failures; used to trigger email fallback

API Gateway (AWS) — rate limiting, JWT auth
   ├── Watchlist Service (Node.js)
   ├── Alerts Service (Node.js)

data_flows.name: Alert trigger
steps: Polygon.io streams real-time trades → Quote Feed Service
Quote Feed publishes {ticker, price, timestamp} to Redis Stream 'quotes'
Alert Evaluator (5 workers in consumer group) reads 'quotes'; loads active alerts for ticker from Redis hash alerts:{ticker}
If alert condition met: publish to Redis Stream 'alert_triggers'
Notification Service reads 'alert_triggers'; calls FCM for push notification
If FCM returns delivery failure: send via SendGrid email after 30s timeout
Update price_alerts record: status → triggered, triggered_at, triggered_price

data_flows.name: Watchlist quote refresh
steps: Mobile app opens Watchlist tab → WebSocket connection to /ws/quotes established
Client sends subscribe message with watchlist tickers
Quote Feed Service forwards trade events from Polygon.io WebSocket to subscribed clients
App goes to background → WebSocket closed; REST poll /api/watchlist every 15s

infrastructure.hosting: All services on existing AWS ECS Fargate cluster in us-east-1. Alert Evaluator: 5 tasks × 0.5 vCPU / 1GB RAM; auto-scales to 20 at market open. Quote Feed: 2 tasks × 0.25 vCPU / 512MB.
infrastructure.cost_estimate: Polygon.io Starter: $29/mo. Redis ElastiCache incremental: ~$12/mo. FCM: free. SendGrid: within existing plan. ECS Fargate Alert Evaluator: ~$45/mo. Total incremental: ~$86/mo for 10K users ($0.009/user/month).
deployment_pipeline: DB migrations via Flyway (run on deploy, rolled back on failure)
ECS Fargate blue/green deployment via CodeDeploy
Alert Evaluator deployed separately — scale to 0 outside market hours via EventBridge schedule
FCM credentials stored in AWS Secrets Manager; rotated quarterly

failure_modes.mitigation: Auto-reconnect with 5s backoff; emit feed_degraded event; suppress alert delivery to avoid stale-price triggers
Fallback to PostgreSQL query for active alerts (≤5s latency increase); PagerDuty alert
Email fallback triggers automatically after 30s FCM timeout
Consumer group offset resumes from last-processed message on restart; max 5min gap at 5-worker restart cadence

security_considerations: All API endpoints require JWT auth; token validated at API Gateway before forwarding to services
WebSocket connection authenticated via JWT as query parameter; connection rejected if token invalid or expired
Alert notification copy reviewed by Legal — must not imply investment advice
User alert data scoped strictly by user_id; no cross-user queries possible by design
FCM device tokens stored encrypted in RDS; purged when user deletes account

open_questions.decision: Exchange data licensing tier upgrade path above 5K simultaneous users
open_questions.recommendation: Negotiate Polygon Business tier ($199/mo) before launch; model at 10K and 50K user milestones
open_questions.risk: Cost spike or forced latency degradation if not planned in advance

open_questions.decision: WebSocket connection management during iOS/Android background lifecycle
open_questions.recommendation: Use REST poll (15s) when backgrounded; WebSocket only in foreground — simpler and avoids background execution limits on iOS
open_questions.risk: Watchlist quote staleness when app is not active — acceptable given we have push alerts

open_questions.decision: Alert evaluation for penny stocks and low-liquidity tickers
open_questions.recommendation: Use last-trade price, not bid/ask; document in user-facing copy
open_questions.risk: Users may perceive false triggers on thinly-traded stocks

features.title: Watchlist Management
features.cross_repo_boundaries: iOS/Android/Web call REST /api/watchlist for CRUD; subscribe to /ws/quotes WebSocket for live prices
features.technical_notes: WebSocket subscription scoped to user's watchlist tickers; REST fallback (15s poll) when app is backgrounded. Cascade delete to price_alerts on ticker removal.
risks: WebSocket connection count at 10K MAU with 20% peak concurrency = 2K simultaneous connections — within Fargate capacity but needs monitoring

features.title: Price Alert Creation & Delivery
features.cross_repo_boundaries: Alert Evaluator reads Redis Streams quotes; Notification Service reads alert_triggers; FCM and SendGrid called from Notification Service only
features.technical_notes: Alert Evaluator must load active alerts for a ticker from Redis on first price event; TTL-based eviction (5min idle) prevents memory bloat. 20-alert cap enforced by Redis counter (user_alert_count:{userId}) — check before INSERT.
risks: Market-open spike: 500+ alerts may trigger simultaneously on large gap moves — consumer group with 20 workers at scale handles this but needs load test
FCM delivery failures on iOS when background refresh is disabled — email fallback is the safety net

features.title: Alert History & Analytics
data_contracts: orders table — join for conversion rate calculation
features.cross_repo_boundaries: All clients read GET /api/alerts/history and GET /api/alerts/analytics; no new cross-service calls
features.technical_notes: 90-day retention enforced by nightly purge job (EventBridge → Lambda). Conversion rate join on (ticker, user_id) between price_alerts.triggered_at and orders.created_at within 24h window. Cache analytics response in Redis for 5 minutes to avoid repeated scans.
risks: Conversion rate join may be slow on users with large alert history — add composite index (user_id, triggered_at) to price_alerts
